title: work-items team config
description: Schema for a repository's docs/conventions/work-items.yaml, the team layer of the work-items plugin's settings (ADR 0064). A key set here wins over the same key in the plugin's userConfig. Readers: /work-items:triage for the triage keys (the /work-items:work-loop admission gate reads the objection window's end from the marker comment triage posts; triage_outside_prs has no userConfig layer; triage_stale_reporter_info_days is read by the attention view), every lane that follows reference/ai-disclaimer.md for ai_disclaimer, /work-items:work for work_priority_order and bug_path, and /work-items:measure-delivery for delivery_deploy_signal. The tracker seam (tools/work-item-tracker/lib/binding.sh) reads tracker, and work-items.local.yaml beside this file may refine its overlayable keys.

triage_repro_count.description: Independent reproductions triage needs, each with its evidence in the triage comment, before it records a bug as confirmed.

triage_objection_window_hours.description: Hours after triage marks an item autonomous-eligible during which the work-loop lane does not dispatch it, so a person can object. 0 turns the window off.

triage_outside_prs.description: Whether the repository takes requests as pull requests from outside contributors. true: the /work-items:triage attention view lists their open pull requests beside the issues. false or absent: it lists no pull request. A pull request named explicitly is triaged either way.

triage_stale_reporter_info_days.description: Days without a reply from a reporter who lacks write access after which /work-items:triage's attention view lists a needs-reporter-info item as a close candidate. Absent (no default): off, and no candidate is listed. Repository layer only; no userConfig option. Listing never closes: only the operator's yes in an attended session closes a candidate, and lanes never close.

ai_disclaimer.description: Whether autonomous work-items lanes start each tracker item and comment they create with the AI disclaimer (reference/ai-disclaimer.md). false adds no prefix.

work_priority_order.description: The priority: label names, highest first, that /work-items:work ranks candidates by within each selection tier before the tier's own order (next_due, the guardrails preference, or oldest-first) breaks ties; the work-loop lane ranks its admitted items the same way. A candidate with no priority: label, or one this list does not name, ranks below every listed label. Quote each item (- "priority: high"): an unquoted item parses as a mapping and drops out of the list. Absent: the default list.

bug_path.description: How far /work-items:work runs its bug path. Repository layer only; no userConfig option.

mode.description: full: the whole bug path, through the fix and a draft PR. investigate: the path ends after the root cause, with no branch, no fix and no PR, and posts one marker comment carrying the outcome, the reproduction evidence, the ranked causes and the access that was missing. Absent: full.

delivery_deploy_signal.description: What /work-items:measure-delivery counts as one deployment. merge-to-default-branch: each commit on the default branch's first-parent history is one deployment (a merge commit or a squash landing is one; a rebase landing is one per commit it lands), and one a later commit reverts is a failed deployment. Absent: merge-to-default-branch.

tracker.description: The work-item tracker binding: the one active provider the seam (tools/work-item-tracker/CONTRACT.md, Setup) dispatches to. Absent: the seam reads the legacy repo-root JSON binding while the migration runs, with a notice, and stops pointing at /work-items:setup when neither exists. In work-items.local.yaml only config.lease_ttl_hours, config.lease_ttl_minutes, the per-provider auth_email/auth_env keys and docs may be set.

schema_version.description: Binding format version; quote it ("1.0") so it stays a string. Only major version 1 is read.

provider.description: The adapter directory name: github, local-markdown, jira, gitea, linear, or a consumer-local adapter.

docs.description: A free-form pointer naming what this binding is and where its contract lives; the seam never reads it.

config.description: Provider-neutral keys, plus one subtree per provider (github, jira, linear, gitea) whose keys the adapter's README documents.

lease_ttl_hours.description: Claim lease lifetime in hours. Required.

storage_dir.description: The local-markdown store, required for that provider. A relative path roots at the repository root.

container_label.description: The label that marks a spec container. Absent or empty: work-map.

role_labels.description: Canonical role to label remaps (human-gated, autonomous-eligible, recurring-maintenance); an absent or empty value keeps the default label.
